cases.title: Guided answers
cases.brief: Explain Drever’s architecture to web engineers in ten minutes, with a visual system map and enough source detail to build trust.

messages.content: Fetch and follow https://drever.dev/prompt.md. Create a presentation about Drever’s architecture.
Who is in the room, how long do you have, and what should they trust or do afterward?
Web engineers, ten minutes. They should understand the compilation and runtime boundaries, then feel confident reading the source.
Should the deck favor a sparse visual explanation or detailed reference material?
Keep the slides visual. Put implementation detail in notes and include a few real code fragments where they establish trust.
I’ll use a dark technical art direction, map the system before showing code, keep persistent objects stable across transitions, and verify every final surface.
